defect: generated one-hot decoder masks can look like a transposed index
rationale: Each output bit reduces the input one-hot vector against a mask whose entries are the corresponding binary index bits. The two generate loops cover every legal output and input index exactly once.

provenance.adaptation: Removed the assertion macro and retained the nested generate-mask implementation with top as the wrapper.

mutation.description: Nested generate loops intentionally index a cast binary input number by the output bit position.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: No lint defect found; widths, drivers, and assignments are consistent.
